_: The Moves and Phone line of every card (A-19 P6). A card not listed under `cards` takes `defaults`. Edit here, run `node .design-sync/moves.mjs`, and the previews and MOVES.md follow; `design-sync-moves.test.ts` fails when they have not. Verbs are the ones in src/lib/motion: press, tint, settle, arrive, unfold, leave, crossfade, glide, flash, bloom, lift, breathe. Every one has a still form, and the line says it.

defaults.moves: Nothing on it moves. Still: the same.

Button.moves: Presses 3%, colour on tint. Busy, its dot breathes and the label and width hold. Still: no scale, the dot holds.
Button.phone: 44px tap floor, through the tablet range; it returns to its dense size at the desktop breakpoint.

ButtonLink.moves: Presses 3%, colour on tint. Still: no scale.
ButtonLink.phone: 44px tap floor, through the tablet range; it returns to its dense size at the desktop breakpoint.

Modal.moves: Settles in (scale 0.98, 8px) with the scrim leading by 40ms; closing fades first, and is quicker. Still: appears and goes at once.
Modal.phone: Becomes a bottom sheet that rises from the edge; its grabber drags it down to close.

ModalHeader.moves: Moves with its dialog. Still: the same.

ModalFooter.moves: Moves with its dialog. Still: the same.
ModalFooter.phone: Its buttons take the 44px tap floor.

RehearsalDialog.moves: Settles in as a Modal; each step tints in where the last was. The result lifts only when something went well. Still: steps swap at once.
RehearsalDialog.phone: A bottom sheet, as every Modal.

PushedStep.moves: Settles in as a Modal. Still: appears at once.
PushedStep.phone: A bottom sheet, as every Modal.

GoTo.moves: Settles in as a Modal. Still: appears at once.
GoTo.phone: Becomes the Go to a page sheet with the Input at its top; the page list stays until something is typed.

GoToPanel.moves: Nothing on it moves. Still: the same.
GoToPanel.phone: Sits above the page list inside the sheet.

AccountSheet.moves: Settles in as a Modal. Still: appears at once.
AccountSheet.phone: A bottom sheet, as every Modal.

ActionOutcome.moves: Done lifts 6px and its dot blooms once; everything else tints in where it stands. A forecast crossfades to the true word. Still: appears in place, no bloom.
ActionOutcome.phone: Wraps under the row; the row's height holds.

StatusDot.moves: Blooms once, only for something that went well because of you. Still: the dot, without the bloom.

EmptyState.moves: Lifts into place when the list just emptied in front of you, and blooms its dot if your act emptied it; otherwise tints in. Still: appears in place.

ArriveList.moves: Rows rise 10px on a first paint you navigated to, 40ms apart, the stagger capped at five; never on Back, refresh, filter or sort. Still: they are simply there.
ArriveList.phone: The same at every width. Carries the list's arrow keys on a keyboard.

LeavingRow.moves: A row that goes on a later read fades where it was, then its gap closes on settle; it waits while the pointer or focus is inside. Still: it goes at once.

TechnicalDetail.moves: Opens by Unfold (settle, contents tint in behind); closes fade first. Nothing inside moves. Still: opens and closes at once.
TechnicalDetail.phone: The same row; the block wraps at the card's width, a long id breaks anywhere, the chevron's seat is 44px.

Unfold.moves: Opens to its own height and pushes the page; closing fades first, then folds. Still: opens and closes at once.

Tinted.moves: Tints in where it appears; nothing travels. Still: appears in place.

UnfoldOnArrival.moves: Opens by Unfold when it arrives late, never twice inside a wrapper. Still: appears at once.

Crossfade.moves: One seat whose words change in place: the old layer fades out and the new fades in on tint, in the same cell, so nothing shifts. Still: the words swap at once.

CopiedSeat.moves: Copy crossfades to Copied for 900ms and a dot that went somewhere blooms once. Still: the word swaps at once.

GlideIndicator.moves: A fill or underline that glides to the choice on settle while the labels tint; outside the travel cap. Still: it jumps.

Segmented.moves: Its indicator glides to the choice on settle. Still: it jumps.
Segmented.phone: Can span its container with equal segments, as the phone sheet's form.

FilterPills.moves: Its indicator glides to the choice on settle. Still: it jumps.

Tabs.moves: Its underline glides to the tab on settle. Still: it jumps.
Tabs.phone: Holds one height on every screen.

PaginationRow.moves: Show more arrives only the new rows; back to ten glides to the heading and trims out of sight. Still: the rows are there, the glide is a jump.

Skeleton.moves: Appears only after 200ms, then tints; a read that lands sooner never shows it. Still: the same.

RowSkeleton.moves: Appears only after 200ms, then tints out as the rows tint in. Still: swaps at once.

ReadFreshness.moves: Only a read you pressed for blooms, for a second. Still: the age, without the bloom.

Notice.moves: Opens by Unfold when it arrives. Still: appears at once.

Sidebar.moves: A count that changed while you looked elsewhere flashes its row once; the number never ticks. Still: the flash stays, colour only.
Sidebar.phone: Hidden below the tablet breakpoint; TouchNav takes its place.

TouchNav.moves: The Go to a page sheet rises from the edge. Still: appears at once.
TouchNav.phone: This is the phone: the tab bar, and the sheet for the rest of the pages.

AppShell.moves: Nothing moves in the frame. Still: the same.
AppShell.phone: The sidebar gives way to TouchNav; the page takes the full width.

SelectionBar.moves: The count changes without ticking: counts never animate. Still: the same.
SelectionBar.phone: The verb the filter was for leads and the rest wait under More changes, a sheet; its buttons take the 44px floor.

Card.moves: Never scales; a pressable one presses to --tint-3. Still: the same.
Card.phone: A row with more than two facts discloses the rest rather than wrapping.

Kbd.moves: None. It is text. Still: the same.
Kbd.phone: Drawn only on the Keys sheet and Go to's footer, which a phone does not show.

KeysSheet.moves: Settles in as a Modal. Still: appears at once.
KeysSheet.phone: A bottom sheet, as every Modal; a phone has no `?` key, so it is opened from a keyboard only.
